name: ohe_anomaly
title: Insulator anomaly branch (PatchCore-style, ResNet-18 features, insulator crops from all detector sources)
summary: Memory bank from 400 normal training crops (31360 patches). Test: 245 normal, 54 defective crops.

results.metric: Defective flagged at val-normal p95 threshold
Normal flagged at the same threshold

notes: Anomaly score is evidence of difference from the normal bank, not a defect class (HLD §6.2).
CPLID 'defect' marks missing insulator caps on transmission lines; railway OHE insulators need their own bank.
railway_catenary_components: real railway cantilever parts (EBIST_cscuav), about 10 images per split; small-sample indicator, evaluation only (licence not stated).
